metadata.version_note: ProtoMotions 3 is a 2025-2026 refactor. Its public MaskedMimic entry verifies the sparse-pose VAE mechanism but differs from the 2024 paper configuration and does not expose the full paper-era text/object pipeline.
metadata.redistribution: No code, checkpoints, robot models, body models, motions, configurations, datasets, or assets are copied.

summary: Pinned official ProtoMotions 3 code exposing sparse future-pose masking, partial-goal context, learned-prior and residual-encoder VAE paths, inference without the privileged encoder, and KL scheduling.
title: NVlabs/ProtoMotions official implementation
